consumer: mission::is_complete for MGOAL_FIND_ITEM, asking the yes/no 'does the player have the required count of the contract item within crafting reach yet?' to decide salvage-contract completion
scope: items reachable for crafting (the character's carried items plus nearby reachable items, via crafting_inventory()), not just on-person carried items and not an arbitrary map region
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) — evaluates u.crafting_inventory().has_amount(type->item_id, item_count) with a charges fallback and returns the engine-computed completion boolean
divergence: the required scrap stacks sit on a tile adjacent to the player (in crafting reach but not carried): the engine's is_complete returns true, but a backend that re-derived the answer from carried-only has_amount (Excerpt 3) or from the per-tile ground-items snapshot (Excerpt 2) reports 'not there yet', exposing the wrong authority/scope
